messages:
noah: Heads-up: SI partner Meridian wants a hands-on integration session showing LangChain + LlamaIndex calling through Redwood Gateway into their orchestrator. They asked for a reproducible demo they can run in a sandbox.

tess: We should avoid sharing long-lived creds. Plan: ephemeral OIDC client + rotating demo secrets, plus an S3 export of audit logs. Meridian also wants a simple UX for switching model variants mid-demo.

diego: UX note: show 'fallback to smaller quantized model' in the orchestrator UI. We can preconfigure routing rules and a canary.

harper: Security: require IP allowlist + ephemeral credentials. Also add HMAC signing for callback webhooks so Meridian can't spoof events.

noah: Can infra spin up a disposable Private deployment in our sandbox org? Prefer Private to avoid cross-tenant noise.

ci-bot: pipeline: created branch partnerships/meridian-demo; added smoke-test job 'meridian-token-rotation' (status: pending)

tess: Infra options: (A) Private sandbox VPC with single-node A10G (fast to provision) or (B) Dedicated reserved pool with strict ingress. Private is faster but requires extra telemetry whitelisting.

diego: For demo determinism, disable prefix caching and fix RNG seed in the prompt adapter. Also bundle a 6-prompt suite that highlights routing.

harper: Legal reminder: don't publish hardware perf or benchmark graphs unless Meridian+HW partner sign disclosure. I'll flag that in the runbook template.

noah: Timeline: Meridian asked for Wed demo; they'd like an internal dry run Mon 2pm PT. Can we do Mon 11am PT internal?

tess: Mon 11am PT internal dry run is fine. I'll provision the Private sandbox by Mon 8am PT.

diego: I'll author the demo orchestration policy and a short terraform snippet for routing: ```resource "redwood_route" "meridian_demo" { default_model = "redwood/llama-quant" canary_percent = 10 }```

harper: I'll prepare the NDA checklist and a short paragraph for comms about the embargo window (suggest 10 days post-signoff).

noah: Action items:
- tess: deploy sandbox Private instance + create ephemeral OIDC client
- diego: demo routing terraform + prompt suite
- harper: NDA + embargo paragraph
- ci-bot: add smoke tests for token rotation and audit export

tess: Putting runbook here: https://redwood.example/r/meridian-runbook (draft)  includes sections: onboarding, token-exchange, smoke-tests, rollback.

diego: I'll open a PR with pytest smoke tests that assert logs hit s3-test-bucket and webhook HMAC verifies.

ci-bot: pipeline: meridian-token-rotation completed (success)

harper: Great. I'll send NDA + dry-run invite to Meridian and CC legal/marketing. Meridian contact is ops@meridian.example.

noah: One more ask: can marketing prepare a short "how we routed to a fallback quantized model" slide for the dev-showcase? Keep it high-level.

tess: Yep. I'll upload a 1-slide summary to the runbook by EOD today.

diego: All good here. See you at Mon dry run. :rocket:
